validity: No human complete region with authenticated assembly/functional boundaries was selected; no fresh whole-region probe overlay and no methylation values. Previous exact-envelope evidence is valid only at its scoped envelopes.
scientific_value: A direct primary-control-versus-secondary-promoter state could guide a future allele-specific primary-tissue assay, but usefulness has not been established. Published human hierarchy, bulk-versus-allelic ambiguity and other mesenchymal-tumor regional changes defeat generic imprinting or MEG3 novelty. Source/chip/purity/lineage alternative and limited independent shared-platform replication would remain even after region/probe suitability.
strongest_alternative: A regional bulk difference can repeat diagnostic lineage/class and stromal admixture without distinguishing primary regulator from downstream promoter or allelic mechanism. Six reference EMC on one chip plus uneven source/purity cannot be repaired by treating Case21 as independent matched replication.
reopening_condition: Primary human whole functional definition (possibly explicitly multiple elements), exact assembly/sequence identity, preselected coherent shared coverage and full quality masks, plus a source-backed novel useful native comparison with all10/62 inventories and Case21/new sources identity/overlap limits. No after-outcome boundary/probe change.
pending: Whole functional CGI regional coverage, alternative direct/native or nanopore IG measurements, new source complete methods and usable public per-sample measurements remain untested/pending. No no-probes-anywhere, no LOI, no transcription, no causality, no new EMC state conclusion.
goal: No publication-worthy EMC finding survived this stage; search remains open.
